title: Sunday · the corner box, again
logline: A landscape Sunday. Highway 101 at Cape Perpetua in June. In the corner: COMING 2009 · THE LONG WAY BACK · a travelogue.

panels.composition: Tier 1: Highway 101 from a Cape Perpetua overlook, June, watercolor at full competence: the road a gray ribbon down the headland, the Pacific enormous, spruce, a single car.

panels.name: Perpetua

panels.composition: Tier 2: the road at eye level, a milepost, the bend north. Empty.
